description: How much of a US stock trades away from the exchanges, from FINRA's OTC transparency data: weekly shares and trades in dark pools (ATSs) and with other off-exchange dealers, and the largest dark pools and dealers in the latest week.

weeks.description: Weeks to show, newest last; default 8. FINRA publishes Tier 1 stocks two weeks after the week, others four.

name: off_exchange_volume

outputSchema.description: rows are weeks, oldest first, with ATS (dark pool) and other OTC shares and trades; latest_week lists the largest venues.

title: Dark pool and OTC volume (FINRA)
